text: there is only 1 part. so if the file on disk says there is 3 parts then its wrong, it had 3 parts that then all got remerged into one part by me intentionally
resolution: The lamp was NOT broken — it was held hostage by a torn two-file save. Forensics: doc.blob on disk is already POST-merge (1 range (0,141), 654 verts, glass boundary 594 intact) but parts.json still lists the 3 pre-merge rows — the authorized merge save wrote doc.blob and the app died (req_3400 freeze) before parts.json followed. The shrink guard took max(docRanges=1, sidecarRows=3)=3 vs live 1 and refused every save since; the merge authorization is an in-memory ref that died with the restart, so there was no way out. Fix 2373b44de: the doc's own range table is the durable boundary authority when it exists — matching its count is allowed and the save REPAIRS the stale sidecar; rangeless legacy docs still defer to the sidecar so the reverse tear (collapsed parts.json vs rich doc) stays refused (existing test pinned + 2 new assertions, 10/10 pass). Recovery: hot reload picks this up — press Save on Lavalampsad once and parts.json heals to the merged single part.
